title: Unreviewed movies
statementMd:
List movies that have no reviews.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `LEFT JOIN reviews ... WHERE r.id IS NULL`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title FROM movies m LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.movie_id = m.id WHERE r.id IS NULL;
```
